# s2_3_drop_images

**In one sentence:** A leftover alias package that only re-exports `materialize` from `prepare_lora_kit/utils/image.py`.

## What's inside
| File / folder | What it does |
|---|---|
| `__init__.py` | Re-exports `materialize` (writes the kept images into the output dir). No code of its own. |

## Who uses it
- Nothing imports this package. `curate/step.py` calls `img_utils.materialize` directly.
- The name survives only as a string in `prepare_lora_kit/utils/state.py` (`_SUBSTEP_MIGRATIONS`: `s2_3_drop_images` -> `drop_images`), used to upgrade old run-state files.
